eva: Quick sync — I pushed a minimal proposal for a schema to support release anchoring + delegated pinning. Goal: let teams hand off pin ownership safely and let runtimes reason about rollback/eviction without long chains. TL;DR: add anchor_kind (hard|soft|delegate), delegated_by, delegate_ttl, lease_id, and variant_hints. feedback?

bmurphy: link?

eva: https://git.redwood/protos/anchoring-skel (copied snippet below)

eva: ```json
{
  "anchor_kind": "delegate",
  "delegated_by": "tenant:ml-pics/rel-2026-02",
  "delegate_ttl": "72h",
  "lease_id": "lease-20260302-42",
  "stable_pin_id": "sha256:abcd...",
  "variant_hints": ["quantized-4bit", "latency-optimized"]
}
```

chen: quick thought: how do we avoid delegation chains? if A delegates to B and B delegates to C we end up with long resolution. :thinking:

frank: prefer explicit lease_id + epoch number. runtime accepts only 1-level delegation; any further delegation must increment epoch and set delegated_by to the previous lease_id. that way you can detect chains easily.

alice: ops question: when we rollback to stable_pin_id, do we expect KV cache invalidation? need to make cache key derivation explicit in spec. otherwise cross-tenant leaks possible.

eva: agreed. propose cache keys = f(stable_pin_id, lease_id). stable_pin_id is immutable content-hash; lease_id changes on delegation/rollout. runtime will drop cache when lease_id != cached_lease_id.

frank: that solves eviction semantics. also suggests we should surface lease_id in telemetry so redeploys can correlate.

bmurphy: telemetry: add lease_id and anchor_kind to request headers for tracing. also incrementally roll out header emission behind a flag.

devops-bot: deploy started: schema/anchoring/v2 -> staging :rocket:

alice: security: delegated_by needs to be verifiable. who can delegate to whom? add signer_id and signature metadata or an acl pointer.

chen: we should avoid adding crypto blobs in every pin record. suggest optional delegation_proof reference (s3://...) and a short 'delegation_policy' enum (owner|tenant-admin|platform) that the control plane enforces.

eva: good tradeoff. default to 'owner' only delegates, platform can override if policy == platform. delegation_proof optional for audits.

frank: one more: variant_hints are advisory only. runtime should have a deterministic downgrade path if hinted variant unavailable (e.g., quantized -> float fallback). document fallback order.

bmurphy: can we piggyback a compact compatibility vector in the pin so runtime can choose compatible fallback automatically? small bitmask of supported features.

eva: yes, add compat_mask (uint16) with documented bit positions. keep it optional.

alice: ops checklist for rollout: 1) emit header in staging 2) validate cache invalidation 3) test delegation edge case where delegate_ttl expires and ownership reverts 4) audit logs include delegation_proof if present

chen: edge-case: what if delegate_ttl expires but new delegate already exists? define ownership precedence: newest lease_id wins, but require non-overlapping TTLs or explicit handoff.

frank: implementer note: control plane should reject overlapping active delegates unless explicit override flag set. simplifies runtime.

bmurphy: I'll add a small compatibility shim in client lib so older clients ignore unknown fields. ensure forward/back compat.

devops-bot: deploy succeeded: schema/anchoring/v2 -> staging :white_check_mark:

eva: thanks all. I'll update the proto with lease_id epoch, compat_mask, delegation_policy, and add the cache key rule. will follow up with a short RFC doc and compatibility playbook.

alice: thanks, will run ops tests tomorrow.

chen: small follow-up: include example curl for header emission?

eva: ```bash
curl -H "X-Redwood-Lease: lease-20260302-42" -H "X-Redwood-Anchor: delegate" "https://api.redwood/v1/generate"
```

frank: looks good. :+1:

bmurphy: lgtm - ship it when RFC lands.
